limits.maxMinutesOf: Time limit in minutes for task {{id}}
limits.maxCostOf: Cost limit in dollars for task {{id}}
limits.taskHint: Agentry warns before it stops the task at this time. The cost limit is enforced by the CLI itself.
limits.graphMinutes: Time limit in minutes for every task
limits.graphCost: Cost limit in dollars for every task
limits.graphHint: A task with limits of its own keeps them. Leave a field empty for no limit.

verification.title: Verification
verification.enableHint: Workers run typecheck and unit tests. The slow checks run once here, on the merged branch, so a whole suite is not started in every worktree at the same time.
verification.commandsHint: One command per line, run in order on the integration branch, each under a timeout. Start a line with “& ” to run it at the same time as the line above.
verification.fixer: Launch an agent to fix what fails
verification.attemptsHint: Per failing command, then it stops and reports

summary.pending: The checks have not started: they run once the graph is merged.
summary.running: The checks are running on the integration branch.
summary.passed: Every check passed on the integration branch.
summary.fixed: A check failed, the fixer mended it and the re-run passed.
summary.failed: A check still fails. Read what it printed before opening a pull request.

verification.holdsPush: The branch can be pushed once the checks have finished.

installHint.detected: Runs before the checks: pnpm, npm or yarn, from the lockfile of the merged branch. Left out when a check already runs it.
installHint.command: Runs before the checks, in the graph's directory.
installHint.none: The checks run on the merged branch as it is.

verification.maxCostHint: Over every attempt of one run. The CLI enforces what is left at each attempt; once it is spent, the checks fail.
verification.failGraph: Fail the graph when the checks fail
verification.failGraphHint: Off, the graph's status is about its tasks and failed checks are only reported. On, the graph ends as failed and no pull request is offered.
verification.failGraphOn: Failed checks fail this graph and hold back its pull request.
verification.costOf: The fixer spent {{cost}} of its {{limit}} limit.
verification.failedGraphBody: Every task finished, but the checks on the merged branch failed and the graph was launched to fail when they do. The verification card below says what failed; checks that pass on a later run bring the graph back.
verification.pullRequestHeld: No pull request is offered: the checks failed and this graph was launched to fail when they do.

templates.noneHint: Save a graph from its page or from the form to run it again on another objective.
templates.launchHint_one: Runs its {{count}} task on the objective and directory below. Nothing here changes the template.
templates.launchHint_other: Runs its {{count}} tasks on the objective and directory below. Nothing here changes the template.
templates.objectiveHint: What this run is for. The tasks keep their prompts.
templates.launchFailed: The template could not be launched
templates.deleteBody: The template is removed. Orchestrations already launched from it are not affected.
templates.editing: Editing the template {{name}}. Saving updates it.
templates.saveHint: Saves this graph so it can be launched again on another objective and directory.
templates.saveFromHint: Saves the graph as it ran, with any corrections made on resume, so it can be launched again on another objective and directory.
templates.name: Name
templates.saveFailed: The template could not be saved
templates.renameFailed: The template could not be renamed

relaunch.title: Edit and relaunch
relaunch.intro: Runs the graph again as a new orchestration with the corrections below. The chats, branches and result of this one stay as they are.
relaunch.failed: The graph could not be relaunched

rerun.title: Re-run {{name}}?
rerun.bodyAlone: It starts over in a new chat and a worktree rebuilt from what it depends on. The graph then integrates and synthesises again, and its earlier result and checks are cleared.
rerun.bodyWithDependants_one: It and the {{count}} task that depends on it start over in new chats. The others keep their chats, branches and results. The graph then integrates and synthesises again, and its earlier result and checks are cleared.
rerun.bodyWithDependants_other: It and the {{count}} tasks that depend on it start over in new chats. The others keep their chats, branches and results. The graph then integrates and synthesises again, and its earlier result and checks are cleared.
rerun.blockedByPullRequest: Tasks cannot be re-run: the integration branch was pushed for a pull request, and rebuilding it would leave that one behind. Relaunch the graph instead.

checks.title: Checks
checks.none: The host has not reported any check for this commit yet.
checks.limited: The host's rate limit is used up. Showing the last list; Agentry reads again at {{time}}.
checks.unavailable: The checks could not be read.
checks.fixHint: A chat will try to fix the checks in the integration worktree and commit on {{branch}}. Nothing is pushed until you press “Push the fix”.
checks.fixPrompt: The project's flow is off, so no chat started. The prompt for a chat of your own is in the response.
checks.fixing: A chat is fixing the failing checks on the integration branch.

log.tailTruncated: Last {{count}} lines of a longer log · secrets hidden

push.title: Fix ready to push
push.body: Agentry fixed what it could and committed it on the integration branch. It pushes nothing until you press “Push the fix”.
push.head: {{noun}} {{ref}} stays on commit {{sha}} until you push it.
push.confirmBody: The fix goes to the {{noun}}, which runs its checks again.

timings.title: Where the time went
timings.label: Where the time went: figures of this orchestration
timings.running: Still running: the figures count up to now.
timings.criticalPathLength: {{duration}} from its first start to its last end
timings.noWaits: No task waited for a slot, a limit or a retry.
timings.missing: Older graph: some phases were not recorded.
timings.error: The figures could not be read.
